document.description: An OML value is one JSON object. Each key is selector:Class and each value is that object's config. A route stores this object in oml, or stores the name of a preloaded file from www/oml.
document.application: Stages, templates, preload, and the first route live in app.json. Read oml://app before building an application. OML config keys for the core components are in oml://attributes. Scripts are in oml://ose.

selectors.meaning: Attach the object to the default element that class creates.
Attach the object to the element with that id.
Attach the object to the element with that class.
Start at the default element, then the descendant that matches .class.
An application view defined in www/js/views.
A vapp key in app.json. This is not the root of a route.
An application controller placed beside the view in the route.
A popup. The selector is its id.
A window. The selector is its id.

keys.name: node:OML
keys.meaning: Child OML. The value is an object, an array of one-key objects, or the name of a preloaded oml file.

keys.name: template
keys.meaning: Template name. The file is www/html/template.Name.html and the value is Name.

keys.name: data
keys.meaning: Object passed into the view. An HTML template reads it as {{$property}}.

keys.name: data:OSE
keys.meaning: An OSE script. {{%}} is the route capture or query object. {{$}} is the current data object. {{json name}} and {{oml name}} load preloaded files.

keys.name: point
keys.meaning: Width ranges, written as 0-479 and 480-5000. Each value is an OML node. A default:Point node uses the same ranges as its own keys.

keys.name: id
keys.meaning: Id used later by cfind, children, and lookup.

rules: Keys and class names are case sensitive.
A class is valid when it is listed in oml://components or defined by the application with require().
Runtime method and property names are not OML keys.
A route does not start with a Stage element or an App element.
node:OML is the only nesting key. Do not invent a children array of elements.
